Subject: Maya Rao — availability windows and preferences

Hi Olga,

Quick intro — I'm Priya from TalentBridge, recruiting for Maya Rao (resume attached). Maya is excited about the role and asked me to share her real constraints so we can stitch a compact virtual loop:

- Timezone: PDT (UTC-7)
- Best day: Thursday 9/30 (morning preferred) or Friday 10/1 (afternoon ok)
- Must finish by 5pm PDT on any day due to child care pickup
- Prefers 3 x 45m interviews rather than 5 short ones; open to a single 90m systems conversation if needed
- Can do a short 20m prep call with recruiter before the loop (optional)

Attachments: maya_resume_redacted.pdf

Happy to coordinate calendar invites once you confirm slot structure.

Thanks,
Priya Singh

priya@talentbridge.io
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Maya Rao — availability windows and preferences

Team — looping you in. Candidate constraints below (Priya's note). I want to propose a compact virtual loop that respects her childcare cutoff and gives us clean debrief windows. Proposed plan for Thu 9/30 (all PDT):

- 09:30–10:15 — Systems deep dive (90m) with Laura (eng lead) + Logan (infra) as primary, short break buffer after
- 10:30–11:15 — Product + prioritization (45m) with me + Marissa (PM/CS lens)
- 11:30–12:15 — Behavioral / culture fit (45m) with Chloe and one IC (flex)

Rationale: 90m block first so we don't fragment the systems convo and can keep the candidate in a flow. We keep the day ending ~12:15 so we finish well before her 5pm constraint. If we prefer not to do a 90m, alternate is 3 x 45m: 09:30, 10:30, 11:30.

Requests:
- Laura / Logan: can you commit to the 90m block? If not, flag and we'll split.
- Marissa: I'll need you to own the post-loop debrief doc so we can give feedback within 24h.

I'll draft the itinerary and send the candidate final schedule + calendar invites once we lock. Also: I can supply a 15m buffer after systems if we foresee tech questions.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure

Olga — 90m is OK for me as long as Logan can join the whole window. My preference would be to do some focused system design + coding exercise in the first 60 and save 30 for architecture trade-offs and Q&A. If we do 3x45 instead, I recommend moving product before systems so the candidate gets context.

Quick note: please keep the system exercise materials to one small shared doc (no heavy IDE setup). We should avoid follow-up scheduling.
